result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there is one clear visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' renders two text strings on top of each other, producing garbled, unreadable text. A secondary minor redundancy exists with the delivery fee shown twice for the same card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time and delivery fee text overlap on the same line (reads like '25–3€0 delivery · Ramen' instead of '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'). The two labels are drawn at the same horizontal position, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Lay the metadata out in a single horizontal flow (e.g., flex row with gap and separator dots) or ensure each text element has its own measured width/position so '25–35 min', '€0 delivery', and 'Ramen' do not collide. Add truncation/ellipsis rules for narrow widths.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' information is duplicated for the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card: once as a badge overlay on the image and again in the metadata line beneath the title, adding visual noise.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery badge only on the image (or only in the metadata line) to avoid repeating the same information twice within one card.
